selection_rationale: High-star backend skill with direct verifier-friendly surface area: URLs, methods, status codes, pagination, filtering, error envelopes, versioning, and rate limiting.
No dependency on private accounts, external cloud permissions, social accounts, or sensitive personal workflows.
Suitable for a single-container task with a realistic partner-facing service and deterministic local data.

rejected_high_star_skills.reason: Depends on external ACP/runtime routing flows rather than a self-contained backend repair task.
Requires authenticated external social-platform operations and introduces account, permission, and privacy risk.

task_shape.runtime: single-container Node.js service with local data files
task_shape.solver_action: repair the existing service implementation instead of generating a report

planned_verifier_focus: Resource naming and stable versioned routes
Consistent success and error response envelopes
Anti-cheat checks against hardcoded fixture-only behavior

real_data_sources.reference_type: refund object fields and refund lifecycle semantics
safe retry behavior for create operations

with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with_skill and without_skill variants.

local_validation.buggy_workspace_expected_result: fails substantive verifier checks for route semantics, pagination stability, replay-safe refund writes, and auth/rate-limit behavior
local_validation.oracle_result: Containerized E2B runs are treated as the authoritative oracle signal for this task; final pass/fail data is collected there.
local_validation.local_test_command: tests/test.sh inside the built task container or via Harbor E2B run

iteration_notes: Do not modify any existing skill.
Final README experiment metrics must come from completed E2B runs only.
Pre-final verifier tuning only relaxed equivalent machine-readable error-code aliases; it did not weaken action-level contract checks.
Latest successful with_skill E2B run: pair12_with_20260501-041408 (9/9 verifier points passed).
Recent without_skill E2B runs still retained action-level failures in refund-state conflict handling or replay-safety requirements.
